title: CKA-Style Practice: Dumpling Annex Bring-up (Kernel, CRI, CNI, CRDs)
description: An original, independent CKA-style practice lab that brings a freshly built node up from the bottom: kernel modules and sysctls that survive a reboot, cri-dockerd installed from its release tarball and proven over CRI, a CNI installed by hand from the reference plugins, and a CustomResourceDefinition you author yourself with validation, defaults, printer columns and a status subresource

steps.title: Kernel prep that survives a reboot
A second runtime: cri-dockerd from the tarball
Network by hand: install a CNI without an operator
Teach the API a new word: author a CRD
